title: Detecting Defective Solar Cells from Defect-Free Examples: A Patch-Memory Study on ELPV
description: On ELPV, 2,624 electroluminescence images of solar cells, a PatchCore-style patch memory built only from defect-free cells reaches ROC AUC 0.893, above logistic regression on the same Wide ResNet-50-2 features given 50 labelled defects (0.874) or 10 (0.823). It reaches 0.875 with only 50 defect-free cells. Cells that experts marked as uncertain (probability 1/3) score between defect-free and defective cells (median score percentile 37.5, against 28.6 and 77.2). Monocrystalline 0.939, polycrystalline 0.876. Code and results; the ELPV data is not included.
